attributes.name: Janeamine
attributes.powers:
Janeamine is immune to the Fire, Electricity, and Poison traits. Before you act, succeed at an Arcane or Divine 12 check or you may not play spells that have the Attack trait.

If undefeated, Janeamine deals no damage; instead, bury all blessings in your hand, or if you have no blessings, bury your hand.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
